nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — EngSpace project memory
EngSpace — anonymous career and salary network for Egyptian engineers
Arabic-first RTL interface (English available, money in EGP)
Yousef — owner (architect / BIM coordinator), first admin
Phase 3: admin console as its own web app behind MFA
Phase 4: store releases
Next: high-impact features (market transparency, daily engineering tools)
nodes.rationale: Chosen with the owner after Phase 2, on the real backend.

nodes.label: Live salary explorer (salary_explorer)
Give-to-get unlock (contributed, read from my_salary_status())
nodes.rationale: Read from my_salary_status() on every hydrate, so a new phone or install is unlocked like the old one.

nodes.label: Offer evaluator + yearly net calculator
Company scorecards (company_ratings, company_scorecard())
nodes.rationale: company_ratings is unreadable by clients; company_scorecard() shows a factor only with ≥ 5 distinct reviewers; jobs.co_name links a job ad to its scorecard.

nodes.label: Raise & inflation tracker (raise_reports, market_raises(), inflation_rates)
nodes.rationale: raise_reports is unreadable; market_raises() needs ≥ 5 reports; staff add each CAPMAS month in Admin → Settings; src/data/inflation.ts must match the migration seed.

nodes.label: Site tools (concrete, rebar, masonry, units)
QA/QC checklists (PDF export, up to 3 photos per item)
nodes.rationale: Items take up to 3 photos (12 per inspection) in the private inspections bucket, printed in the report's photo appendix.

nodes.label: 5-report floor (≥ 5 reports per aggregate cell)
Salaries are NET (الصافي) everywhere
nodes.rationale: Model, companies, shares, tools and labels all use net pay; gross appears only in the net ⇄ gross calculator; pre-net salary_shares rows were converted and gross_original kept.

nodes.label: private.net_of_gross() — SQL mirror of netPay()
nodes.rationale: Tests pin both private.net_of_gross() and netPay().

nodes.label: Money by role (engineers individual figures, HR/owner aggregates, field staff none)
nodes.rationale: Field staff's Tools tab shows only the site tools + checklists (blockedFor(...).toolsOnly, toolOpen); HR's Tools tab offers CV review only.

nodes.label: Staff roles (profiles.staff moderator / admin; role stays engineer)
nodes.rationale: Moderators hide / restore; only admins delete for good; staff reach the console from the header on every device.

nodes.label: admin_delete_content() — permanent delete by admins
nodes.rationale: Replies, reactions, authorship and the post image go too.

nodes.label: admin_directory — admins-only member directory keyed by pid
nodes.rationale: Never shows mod_ref or moderation state, so names can't be joined to anonymous reports.

nodes.label: admin_accounts — mod_ref list with moderation fields only
nodes.rationale: Carries only moderation fields, so names can't be joined to anonymous reports.

nodes.label: admin_message — team messages arrive as «فريق EngSpace»
Support tickets (support_tickets / ticket_messages, private support bucket)
nodes.rationale: Every member can answer a team thread and reach the team from Messages.

nodes.label: One tap = one salary report (client lock + 10-minute server dedupe)
nodes.rationale: The client sends once (button locked, contribute guarded) and the server refuses an identical report from the same member within 10 minutes (23505, treated as «already recorded»).

nodes.label: salary_shares table (net salary, gross_original, employer type)
E+S brand mark (src/ui/brand-mark.json) and icon generation
nodes.rationale: Polygons live in the 1024 space of the owner's master icon assets/icon-only.png — never redraw it; render.mjs, web.mjs and @capacitor/assets generate every size (delete the icons/ and manifest.webmanifest it also writes).

nodes.label: Content sharing via shareContent() (share sheet → navigator.share → copy link)
nodes.rationale: Links use VITE_PUBLIC_URL when set, else the web hash route, else app.engspace://open/<type>/<id>; a link opened signed-out waits for the sign-in (takePendingOpen).

nodes.label: app.engspace:// deep-link scheme (open/<type>/<id>, auth-callback)
nodes.rationale: The Android intent filter host is open.

nodes.label: Zoom lock (v0.1.8: viewport meta, touch-action, gesture listeners, native views)
BiDi isolation of member text (translate=no, dir=auto, <bdi dir=ltr> numbers)
nodes.rationale: Member-written text (posts, comments, chat) is never translated and is rendered with unicode-bidi: isolate; numbers sit in <bdi dir=ltr>.

nodes.label: Realtime private channels (member:<id>, feed, staff)
nodes.rationale: member:<id> carries verification, profile and notices; feed carries post / moderation changes; staff reloads the console.

nodes.label: Discipline-first job matching (SQL filter + client matchJob gate)
nodes.rationale: Experience and city only count after the discipline matches.

nodes.label: Employer type on salary shares (salary_shares.employer: مقاولات / استشاري / مالك)
nodes.rationale: Kept in employer, never in company.

nodes.label: Seeded test accounts (@engspace.test, ten roles)
nodes.rationale: Passwords are never in the repo (bcrypt hashes only); remove the accounts before launch.

nodes.label: Playwright e2e suite (iPhone 15 + Pixel 7 profiles, E2E_LIVE / E2E_WEBKIT)
Author controls on posts (v0.1.9)
nodes.rationale: Which posts are mine comes from my_posts() on every hydrate (never guessed from the client); delete always asks first; edited posts show «معدّل» with the count.

nodes.label: edit_my_post() — own post, counts only real text changes
nodes.rationale: Refused for hidden / suspended posts; posts.edit_count and edited_at are server-set.

nodes.label: delete_my_post() — removes replies, reactions, authorship and the image
nodes.rationale: The media: read own select policy lets the Storage image removal work.

nodes.label: my_posts() — server answer to which posts are mine
Screen-layer navigation + memoised tab panes (v0.1.14)
nodes.rationale: Pop is a compositor-only CSS animation with no View Transitions; panes re-render only when paneSig changes, so any new store key a tab renders must join PANE_KEYS; layout effects never read scrollTop (scrollMem); edge swipe-back writes transforms directly; long-lived listeners read appNow.

nodes.label: QA/QC checklist builder (qcbuilder, UserTemplate)
nodes.rationale: Synced as member_state qcTemplates with tombstones; an inspection keeps a tpl snapshot so deleting a checklist never breaks it.

nodes.label: Executive A4 inspection report (inspectionPdf, signatures, REPORT_PROMO)
CV review regional HR realism (features/cv/hr.ts)
nodes.rationale: Birth date, marital status, nationality, photo and a local phone are normal — only the national ID is flagged; Syndicate registration is optional and never scored; military service is checked for male Egyptian engineers; every report carries result.hr and result.regional.

nodes.label: member_state — per-member synced key/value store
Tools suite wave 1 (v0.28.0)
nodes.rationale: Stack types tool (#app/tool/<id>) and tooldoc (#app/tooldoc/<kind>:<docId|new>); a new document gets its id on the first edit via app.replaceTop; field tools have no price fields.

nodes.label: Tool registry + role gate (src/tools/registry.ts, gate.ts)
nodes.rationale: One role allow-list per tool: supervisors never reach a money tool and HR only the CV review — checked in push, the render switch, AppHeader and openTool.

nodes.label: Document kit (src/doc: DocSpec → docLayout → raster PDF backend)
nodes.rationale: Pure mm layout with the issuer's title block, running header and paged tables; 240 dpi lossless 16-colour pages; renderDoc never rejects; canvas ignores LRI/PDI so lines without Arabic are drawn LTR; a plain letterhead mode serves the CV.

nodes.label: Tool store (src/lib/tool-store.ts: IndexedDB + member_state shards)
nodes.rationale: IndexedDB first; documents sync through member_state shards toolIndex + toolShelfA…L with per-document merge (conflict copy, tombstones); never rejects.

nodes.label: Pure tool engines (src/domain/tools/*) + lazy tool screens
nodes.rationale: Engines are pure and tested against the blueprint's vectors; each screen family is a lazy chunk listed in module.ts.

nodes.label: CV hiring panel — four readers (ATS, hiring manager, recruiter, teammate)
nodes.rationale: Pure, on the device, no AI; ISSUE_OWNERS names who raised each issue; gradeIntel reads Egyptian grades as advice only, never scored; projectScore counts only facts the CV already has.

nodes.label: Rebuilt CV draft (rebuild.ts + translate.ts, [ADD: …] slots)
nodes.rationale: Same facts with rewrites; national ID, religion and street address dropped, military made explicit, never the Syndicate; uncertain items become slots the engineer fills before exporting; every draft number must come from the CV.

nodes.label: White-label CV export (plain PDF + editable .docx)
nodes.rationale: Plain mode prints no EngSpace mark, credit or document number and the PDF metadata carries only the engineer's name; the .docx is minimal OOXML zipped with fflate on the device.

nodes.label: CV report executive snapshot + collapsible action plan
nodes.rationale: Dual ring now → projected, screen before → after, top 3 fixes from actionPlan; touch targets ≥ 44 px.

nodes.label: Dev-only window.__engspace* stand-ins driven by e2e
nodes.rationale: Development / test builds expose stand-ins (__engspaceOta, __engspaceCamera, __engspaceAi) so e2e can drive updater, camera and AI paths without devices or network; they are never in production builds.

nodes.label: Append-only migrations (never edit applied ones)
nodes.rationale: Add new files; never edit applied migrations once the hosted project exists.

nodes.label: Committed fixed debug keystore (android/app/debug.keystore)
nodes.rationale: One fixed debug key so each preview APK installs over the last; a random CI key makes Android refuse the update.

nodes.label: SQL conventions (security definer + search_path = '', (select auth.uid()) policies)
nodes.rationale: Fully qualified names and an explicit grant execute … to authenticated; index every column a policy filters on.

nodes.label: Multi-line readable code convention (Biome in Phase 2.1)
nodes.rationale: Comments explain why; no more long single-line handlers; Phase 2.1 adopts Biome and reformats the rest in one mechanical commit.

nodes.label: Glass only on the floating tab bar (html[data-glass=lite] fallback)
nodes.rationale: Android without headroom gets data-glass=lite with no live blur.

nodes.label: Pushed screens hide the tab bar (.pushed, --tabbar-space: 0, .foot)
nodes.rationale: A bottom action bar carries .foot and pads for the home indicator itself.

hyperedges.label: Secrets stay server-side (function secrets / Vault / GitHub secrets, never the client or repo)
Deletion leaves nothing behind (content, authorship and media go together)
